name: Cafe La Baguette
source:
You just moved into a new town called La Crescent street and got a job from one of the best cafes in town.

You will meet new friends, new foes.. even one or two of them knowing this is a simple game. Will you win their heart, or will you not?

[From [url=https://itsfroggy.itch.io/cafe-la-baguette]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚搬到一个名为La Crescent Street的新城镇，并在当地最好的咖啡馆之一找到工作。

你会结识新朋友，也会遇到新对头……其中甚至有人知道这只是一场游戏。你能赢得他们的心吗？

[来源：[url=https://itsfroggy.itch.io/cafe-la-baguette]Itch.io[/url]]
